people.role: Stablemaster of the wardens' hall and its mule-doctor; a Pivot-born caravan driver
people.backstory: He drove the fourth wagon of Trang Thiết Cước's (trang_thiet_cuoc) column in 1190, one of the drivers the hall kept, and joined to stay with the mules; he says they smelled wolf from the first night out of Tùng Hạ.

ties.note: the warden who stood by his wagon

tree.intent: A body that walks all night; staff work.

build.note: Staff on the loi_truong base, like Xuyên Lâm's staff (no staff base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: Whip scar round one wrist, a bell-clapper charm at his neck.

people.role: Tracker of the Bạch Lang road; reads wolf sign
people.backstory: A hunter of Liệp Hộ who shot beside Diêm Lạc Nhạn (diem_lac_nhan) long before the hall; she found the new wolf sign on the Bạch Lang road this autumn and agrees with her friend that the head's mercy brought it. She sent Lâm Tiểu Tiễn (lam_tieu_tien) up the road alone at night to find sign, and never asked how it went.

ties.note: they hunted together before the hall

tree.intent: Arrows that pin; patience on a track.

build.note: Bow on the cham base (no bow base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: One ear missing its lobe; she crouches to smell the ground.

people.role: Outer warden from Phạt Mộc; walks the night watch
people.backstory: He walked the recruitment night on the Tùng Hạ - Cổ Độ road and was still talking at dawn, which Cảnh Dạ Tuần (canh_da_tuan) counted in his favour; Vương Tiều Nhi (vuong_tieu_nhi) knew him in Phạt Mộc and pretends she did not. He halts the night watch only when someone is lost on the road, and says why aloud.

build.note: Staff on the loi_truong base, like Xuyên Lâm's staff (no staff base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: Sunburnt nose, blister-hard right hand, and he talks to the dark.

people.role: Inner warden; the timber magistrate's daughter, who ran from Tùng Gian to her uncle's hall
people.backstory: Her father, the timber magistrate of Tùng Gian, calls the hall a disgrace; she walked out of the city to her uncle Hứa Vãn Cung (hua_van_cung) at sixteen, and her father has not written since.

build.note: Bow on the cham base (no bow base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: Her magistrate's good green silk is patched twice at the knee with hall cloth.

people.role: Outer warden from Bạch Lang; a tracker in training
people.backstory: Born in the wolf village of Bạch Lang, she can follow a pack's track on frozen needles; she has not decided whether she wants the wolves dead like her master Từ Tiễn Sương (tu_tien_suong) or gone, like the head.

ties.note: the warden of her home road

build.note: Bow on the cham base (no bow base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: Keeps licking her chapped lips; the wolf's-tooth necklace is too big for her.

people.role: Inner warden of the counting-house; counts caravan fees and walks the roads he counts
people.backstory: A Tùng Hạ market boy who reckons fees in Trang Thiết Cước's (trang_thiet_cuoc) counting-house by day and walks the caravans he billed by night, because the hall's rule says he must; Trang Tiểu Đà (trang_tieu_da) copies his sums. Once a season he sells the caravan schedules to a Cổ Độ gang for a cut, and last season Cảnh Dạ Tuần (canh_da_tuan) lost two mules to it.

build.note: Staff on the loi_truong base, like Xuyên Lâm's staff (no staff base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: A bone abacus in his sleeve, and chalk dust on his boots.

people.role: Outer warden in the shooting yard
people.backstory: A Thanh Tùng boy who strings his own bows and wants every wolf that ever followed a caravan dead, as his master Diêm Lạc Nhạn (diem_lac_nhan) does. She pays him a pelt for each running wolf, and he has four. This autumn, three days out of Tùng Hạ, he left a mule-driver at the wagons to run one down, and the pack took the driver's leg.

ties.note: pays him a pelt for each running wolf
the road's warden, who cut his arrow out of the wolf

build.note: Bow on the cham base (no bow base yet: Item DB open question).

people.appearance: Bowstring grooves across two fingers, four wolf-tail tassels at his belt, and he cannot sit through a meal.
